summary: NOW: EARF is a San Francisco design brand making hi-fi and light in tinted cast acrylic: Tropos (powered horn loudspeaker, locked: on its own feet, no light, smooth polished horn A), Mantle (record player/turntable: Strata Float v3 signed; its light, its look in the deep tints and its word open; no approved picture), Core (cordless lamp, design B, inner ball to be made concentric) and Hemisphere (pendant, color outside, being redesigned to glow like "Core cut in half"). The line is "A world of sound, in color." One material, one dye per tint; seven tints are pictured (Ember, Dust, Acid, Poison, Ice, Haze, Fog). Smoke is out only by the coordinator's call: at 01:49 the owner said he still wants it rendered as ideally wanted and worked back to a pour, so seven-or-eight is open; Poison's name is also open. The mark is the multicolor acrylic globe with the circle-and-square wordmark; the owner likes the rendered globe but wants it in today's speaker colors and finds "as an object" cheap; the rendered marks fail the honesty audit. Voice: cheeky, but reserved. Pictures: honest renders from the approved list only (seven fronts, turns, seven horn-backs, the Ember amp plate, the Ice habitat). Packaging, the big ideas, the reserved names, EARFcoin's size, the bar's plan and every price are proposals. GOING: concept first, then execution; a prototype pair plus one of each lamp and Mantle and a spring debut (no date) on a raise of about $55,000; the launch-film website, live on his yes; Planet EARF as a configurable listening-bar showroom and Mother EARF as its centerpiece (in principle, not funded or named in public); special editions with inclusions and bubbles; more acrylic objects (in principle). The v23 Book states as settled 31 things that are not decided, chief among them the seven-color count, Mantle's light (corrected only in the later version 1794275254-44ef), Hemisphere's and Core's lamp details, Poison, the posts, the rendered marks and every proposal chapter. The investor deck (v1793686214-3dc9) is history: eight colors with Smoke, lit plinths, the stepped 22-layer horn, 660 x 670 x 1336 mm and about 85 kg, superseded prices and "things the air holds". Owner messages read through 02:03:57Z (the last, about where to send updates, is not a brand decision). Every quote and line reference was checked by script against its source.
